facts.claim: A plot owner inside the corporation limits may apply to fell a tree on that plot.
facts.subject: tree_felling_permit
facts.evidence: Any owner of a plot inside the corporation limits may apply to fell a tree standing on that plot.

facts.claim: The current year's property tax receipt must be attached to the application.
facts.subject: tree_felling_permit
facts.evidence: The applicant must attach a copy of the property tax receipt for the current year.

facts.claim: The fee is 200 rupees per tree, paid online with the application.
facts.subject: tree_felling_permit
facts.evidence: The fee is 200 rupees per tree, payable online at the time of application.

facts.claim: A complete application is decided within 15 working days.
facts.subject: tree_felling_permit
facts.evidence: The permit is issued within 15 working days of a complete application.

facts.claim: The permit is applied for online only, through the Example Services Portal.
facts.subject: tree_felling_permit
facts.evidence: Applications are accepted only through the Example Services Portal.
